attr.title: Mega Man X Recompiled
attr.desc: Experimental native ARM64 Mega Man X Recompiled port for RG35XX-H and PortMaster.
attr.inst: Requires your own Mega Man X (USA) (Rev 1) ROM. After installation, place it at /roms/ports/megamanxrecompiled/mmx/mmx.sfc. Optional X2/X3 ROMs are not included. The autoinstall ZIP contains no ROMs.
